description:
See what's behind the wall before you open it.

The Cutaway House explains home and garden projects with precise 3D cutaways. Walls, floors and the ground are sliced open so you can see exactly how everything fits together: wiring, plumbing, drainage, irrigation, decks, fences, paths and everything in between.

Every video is built on the actual codes and manufacturer instructions, like the National Electrical Code and the International Residential Code. Every measurement is shown in inches and millimeters, with real-world examples and practical tips to get the job done right the first time.

Whether you're fixing something small, planning a renovation or building in the backyard, you'll know what goes where, how deep, how far and why.

This channel is for education only. Codes vary by location and your local inspector has the final word. Always shut off the power or water, test before you touch, and hire a licensed pro when the job calls for one.
